div.l: For it was of no superfluyte
But of greet norisshinge and digestible
His stody was but litil on the bybyll
In sangwen and in perce I clad with all
Lyned with taffata and whit sandall
And litil he was of his dispence
He kepte that he whan in the pestelence
For gold in phisik is a cordial
Therfore he loued gold in special
A Good wif ther was of beside bathe
And she was somdeel deef ⁊and þᵗat was scathe
Of cloth makynge had she suche an haunt
She passid hem of ypre or of gaunt
In al the parisshe wif was ther non
That to the offrynge before hir sholde goon
And if ther did certayn wroth was she
Than was she oute of al charite
Her kercheuys ful fyn were of ground
I durste swere they weyed thre pound
That on a sunday were on hir hed
Hir hosyn were of fyne scarlet reed
Ful streyte I teyd and shoos ful newe
Bold was her face fair ⁊and reed of hewe
She was a worthy womman al hir lyue
Husbondis at the chirche dore hadde she fyue
Withoute other companye in youthe
But her of nedith not to speke as nowthe
At acres had she been and at Iherusaleme
She had passid thouron many a stronge reme
